messages:
Maria R.: morning folks — quick handoff from me before I jump off. key things:
- CI: intermittent failures in `embed-tests` (flaky assertion on 2/20 runs). repro locally with `pytest tests/embeds/test_index.py::test_bulk_index -k slow`
- Canary: rolling out v3.2.1 to canary pool at 11:30 UTC (eu-1). plan: 10% traffic -> 30% after 15m if no errors.
- Watchlist: eu-1 lat p95 is creeping +30ms after last deploy, likely from a new kernel selector change. keep an eye on p95 and KV cache evictions.
- Action: I created ticket RW-1289 to track the embed-test flake and pinned a suspect commit.

Aj Patel: thanks — I can take the midday bridge. I will: 1) follow canary progress, 2) trigger a manual rerun of failing CI jobs every 15m if they pop, 3) escalate to runtime if lat keeps rising. ping me with @Aj if anything spikes :thumbsup:

Sasha G.: noted. re: KV cache evictions, we saw a small spike in evict counts around 11:08 UTC correlated with a prefetch burst. i'll drop a quick snippet to add a temporary alert: 
```
alert: high_kv_evictions
expr: sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool) > 50
for: 3m
```
Will add in staging, then prod if green.

CI Bot: CI pipeline detected 3 failures in `embed-tests` in the last 6 runs (jobs 4821, 4824, 4830). Flake candidate: timeout on external-vector-store mock.

Oncall Bot: scheduled shift swap reminder for Aj at 11:25 UTC. Next oncall: Sasha (12:00 UTC).

Maria R.: extra notes — demo tomorrow uses canary traffic; if the canary doesn't reach 30% by 11:50, hold the demo and I will reschedule. also, there is a new CR from @Sasha in PR #4867 that updates batching config for embeddings — it's small but impacts latency. pls prioritize review.

Aj Patel: will review #4867 now. if I see anything odd i'll drop comments, else i ll approve after unit tests. also i started a quick local run with `--captures=no` to try to repro the CI flake.

Sasha G.: thx. FYI taking a lunch break 12:20-12:50 UTC but reachable on pings. leaving runbook links here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-rollout and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-debug

Maria R.: last thing — if you see datastore errors in canary (5xx), fallback policy is to route to warm pool and notify #incidents. i also updated the canary slack hook to ping this thread on criticals.

Aj Patel: acked. i'll post a short summary at 12:00 with canary metrics (error rate, p95 latency, kv evictions).

Sasha G.: approved #4867 and added one nit, nothing blocking. :rocket:

Maria R.: thanks team — handing off. Maria out.
